full_prompt_en: The image is a square nineteenth-century oil painting of a seated man and woman in formal clothing beside a low stone ledge, with a small dog at the lower right. The upper background shifts from cloudy pale sky at the left to dark trees and foliage behind the pair on the right. At the far left, a younger figure in patterned clothing is partly visible behind the man's shoulder, cropped by the edge. The man occupies the left foreground, wearing a deep burgundy jacket over a dark waistcoat and a richly patterned golden neckcloth. He has dark curly hair and a full beard, and he leans toward the woman with one bent arm and hand near his face. His other hand rests low against brown trousers. Across the center, the weathered pale stone ledge separates the pair's upper bodies from the layered clothing below. The woman sits on the right in a white lace-trimmed off-shoulder bodice and a large plum-purple skirt that fills most of the lower center. Her brown hair is gathered up, and her face tilts toward the man with a quiet, downcast gaze. One hand touches the side of her head; the other rests on the skirt, with a narrow bracelet visible at the wrist. Near the lower right, a small dark-and-white shaggy dog looks toward the couple, partly cropped by the frame. The man's burgundy velvet-like surface and the woman's dark purple folds contrast with the delicate white lace around her shoulders. Light arrives from the upper left and front, touching faces, lace, stone, and the dog's pale fur while the trees behind remain dark. The paint models skin smoothly and gives heavier fabric and foliage denser, more textured strokes. The viewpoint is close to seated eye level, compressing the figures into an intimate group rather than opening a wide landscape. The overall composition uses a dark green-brown surround and warm burgundy against a bright pale face and lace, concentrating attention on the pair's restrained exchange.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形十九世纪油画，一名男子和一名女子穿正式服装坐在低石栏旁，右下角有一只小狗。上方背景从左侧带云的浅色天空过渡到两人身后的右侧深色树林。最左边一位穿花纹衣服的较年轻人物只在男子肩后露出一部分，被画边裁切。男子占据左前景，穿深勃艮第红外套，里面是暗色马甲，颈间系着花纹繁复的金色领巾。他有深色卷发和浓密胡须，朝女子倾身，一只手臂弯起，手靠近面部；另一只手低低搁在棕色裤子上。中央横过的磨旧浅色石栏把两人的上半身同下方叠起的衣料分开。女子坐在右侧，白色蕾丝饰边的露肩上衣下是一条占据下部中央大片面积的梅紫色长裙。棕发盘起，她向男子微偏脸，眼神安静而低垂。一只手碰着头侧，另一只手放在裙上，手腕露出一道细手镯。右下方一只毛茸茸的黑白小狗朝两人望去，身体被画边裁掉一部分。男子勃艮第红近似天鹅绒的表面与女子深紫褶裙，对照肩头细致的白蕾丝。光从左上偏前进入，触及面孔、蕾丝、石栏和小狗的浅色毛，后方树木保持深暗。颜料平顺塑造皮肤，厚布和树叶则用更密、更有纹理的笔触。视点靠近坐姿人物的眼睛高度，把两人压缩成亲近的一组，没有展开宽广风景。整体构图以深绿棕环境和暖勃艮第红，衬托明亮浅色脸庞与蕾丝，让注意力集中在两人克制的交流上。
style_prompt_en: Detailed oil painting combines smooth tonal modeling in its light focal planes with denser brush texture in surrounding dark masses. Deep burgundy, plum, olive, and brown gather across most of the frame, while cream-white highlights form a concentrated contrast. Heavy folds turn in broad curved planes, set against finer lace-like edges and weathered matte surfaces. Faces and principal contours remain carefully resolved; outer edges soften into layered foliage and shade. Warm directional light from the upper side lifts selected planes without flattening the deep green-brown recesses. A close, slightly compressed grouping creates intimacy, and a horizontal middle band stabilizes the overlapping diagonal forms. The overall effect is rich, restrained, and tactile, with value contrast directing the eye through an otherwise dense arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 细致油画把亮部焦点平面上平顺的明暗塑形，与周围深色大形体里更密的笔触纹理结合。深勃艮第红、梅紫、橄榄与棕色聚在画面大部分区域，奶油白高光形成集中的反差。厚重褶面以宽阔弧面转折，对照更细的蕾丝状边缘与磨旧的哑光表面。主要轮廓被精心确定，外围边缘柔化到交叠暗影中。暖色上侧定向光提亮选定平面，却没有抹平深绿棕色内凹处。近距离、略压缩的组合制造亲密感，中部一条水平带稳住互相重叠的斜形。整体效果浓郁、克制且可感，明度反差引导视线穿过密集排列。

theme_zh: 一对衣着正式的男女坐在石栏旁，身边有一只小狗
name: William Powell Frith
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
